item.statement: The study did not analyze how varying the elemental composition of the FeNiCrCoCu alloy affects its wear resistance.
quotes: We did not analyze the effect of changes in the proportion of elements in the FeNiCrCoCu high entropy alloy material on wear resistance.
Subsequent analysis can be conducted by changing the proportion of elements to obtain the external influencing mechanism.

item.statement: While hardness remains stable between 300 K and 600 K, the elastic modulus increases significantly due to a reduction in dislocation density, but this trend reverses at higher temperatures.
quotes: At 300 K and 600 K, the ordered lattice structure of the high entropy alloy coating material is basically the same, and thus its hardness is basically the same.
However, the dislocation density at 600 K is significantly reduced compared with that at 300 K, resulting in an increase of the elastic modulus of the material from 173 GPa to 219 GPa.

item.statement: Increasing temperature leads to higher friction coefficients and tangential forces due to lattice disorder, but simultaneously causes a sharp decrease in normal force and hardness due to thermal softening.
quotes: With the increase of temperature, the disorder of the lattice structure increases, which leads to an increase of the tangential force and friction coefficient in the friction process.
When the temperature reaches 900 K, the wear resistance of the FeNiCrCoCu high entropy alloy coating decreases sharply.
